department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Clarence M. Mitchell, Jr. School of Engineering

deadline.value: School of Graduate Studies sets April 1 as the Fall application deadline for international F-1 degree-seeking applicants (unless an earlier program deadline applies); Morgan's Application Deadlines portal lists May 1, 2027 for Computer & Electrical Systems Engineering, PhD (Fall 2027), and SGS funding applications are due April 30.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines for the School of Graduate Studies (SGS) are as follows (unless earlier deadline dates are indicated by the individual programs): ... International, degree-seeking (All F-1 in and out of USA) Fall - April 1

also.quote: Computer & Electrical Systems Engineering, PhD Saturday, May 1, 2027 Fall 2027 Graduate Computer & Electrical Systems Engineering, PhD

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Electrical & Computer Engineering; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students form a doctoral advisory committee by the end of their first year after admission; no pre-admission advisor requirement is stated.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships (TA/RA, $21,000 doctoral stipend plus tuition award up to 9 credits/semester excluding university fees) and fellowships require a separate School of Graduate Studies funding application (due April 30 for Fall) and are not guaranteed.
funding.quote: SUBMISSION OF A FUNDING APPLICATION DOES NOT MEAN YOU WILL BE APPROVED. The decisions will be based on program selection and availability of funding per each program. | Graduate assistantships for doctoral and master's degree students pay a stipend ($21,000-doctoral $12,000-master's) Tuition awards do not pay for university and miscellaneous fees.

entry_route.value: Requires a minimum of 60 graduate credit hours beyond a bachelor's degree (with pass-through en passant M.S.) or 36 credits beyond a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Complete a minimum of 36 graduate credit hours (including 9 hours of dissertation-related research) of study beyond the Master's degree or complete a minimum of 60 graduate credit hours of study beyond the bachelor's degree

notes: Includes a pass-through (en passant) M.S. in Computer and Electrical Systems Engineering. Morgan State's ECE department and CAP faculty also offer a Ph.D. in Secure Embedded Systems (same April 1 international / May 1, 2027 Fall deadlines, 3.3 GPA, 60 post-BS / 36 post-MS credits).
name: Computer and Electrical Systems Engineering
